key_impacts: Over 13 lakh people evacuated ahead of landfall.
Coastal areas faced fierce winds and storm surge.
National highways and other important roads were closed to regular traffic.
Gopalpur recorded a 185 kph gust; mean winds near 120 kt.
evidence_snippets: "Due to the cyclone there were 21 deaths"
missing_information: Storm surge height and inundation extent

key_impacts: Subsequent floods caused 23 additional deaths in Odisha and 1 in Andhra Pradesh.
Significant flooding occurred in Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh.
